column1: # Model pack `image` (MODEL_PACKS=image, the default): every model ImageLab's image, style, edit and workflow features need.
# Columns (tab separated, one header row, same shape as Map Maker's duel-maps deploy/models/3d.tsv): url, ComfyUI models
# folder (under MODELS_DIR), exact file name, size in bytes, sha256. `civitai:<versionId>` expands to
# checks bytes and sha256 before a file gets its name, and never overwrites or deletes (add-only). Sizes come from
# Comfy Cloud's asset listing / Hugging Face headers; hashes from the Hugging Face paths-info API (LFS oid) and the
# Civitai model-version API, or from the file itself for the few hosts with no hash API (GitHub releases, taesd).
# The two-pass Illustrious workflow: pass 1 on plain WAI (no lora, no merge) decides the
# composition, then the latent is upscaled 1.25x and repainted by pass 2 on the style stack below. All five files
# are required by it; the names are the ones the graphs ask for, which are Comfy Cloud's names, not Civitai's
# (wai-illustrious-sdxl.safetensors is Civitai's waiIllustriousSDXL_v150.safetensors renamed on download).
# Anima files are the diffusion model only (no text encoder, no VAE), so they go in diffusion_models for UNETLoader,
# never in checkpoints: CheckpointLoaderSimple cannot load them.
# --- BiRefNet_toonout for ComfyUI-RMBG (exactly the files/layout the node's own downloader would create) ---
# --- AnimeLineArtPreprocessor weights for comfyui_controlnet_aux (ckpts dir is symlinked here by start.sh) ---
# --- TAESD previews (--preview-method taesd); names must start with what comfy/latent_formats.py expects ---
# --- SDXL ControlNets for Illustrious / NoobAI (fp16). No NoobAI openpose exists; use the xinsir union (promax) for pose. ---
# --- comfyui_controlnet_aux preprocessor weights (ckpts/<repo>/<file>, exactly where custom_hf_download looks) ---
# --- ImageLab Style tab (2026-10-20): every reference type's files, picked by name (lib/styleRefs.ts pickModel / pickLora /
#     pickControlnet). SD 1.5 + SDXL style / subject (PLUS), SD 1.5 composition (ostris), FaceID Plus v2 + its LoRAs, FaceID
#     Portrait, InstantID (SDXL; its ControlNet in controlnet/instantid/, the name the pack's examples use) and its antelopev2
#     face model, PuLID SDXL. buffalo_l (FaceID's face model) is fetched by insightface itself on first use. ~9.6 GB.
# Flux Redux (Style tab, Flux models): the SigLIP vision model is public; flux1-redux-dev is gated on Hugging Face (401
# without a token, and download-models.sh sends none), so it stays out until there is an ungated mirror or an HF token here.
# --- WD14 tagger (the pack's models/ dir is symlinked to models/wd14_tagger by start.sh) ---
# --- Face restore (facerestore_cf; ImageLab's Edit tools, Face restore). CodeFormer, since the tool's fidelity slider is
#     CodeFormer's. The pack downloads its detector and face parser into models/facedetection on first use; listing them
#     here means a worker with a read-only or offline models share still has them. All three from the pack's README links.
# --- Upscalers (2x-AnimeJaNai has no stable HF home; skipped) ---
